item.title: This supernova impostor baffled astronomers for 15 years — until they found a hidden black hole feeding on an unstable star
item.description: A cosmic imposter that has faked being a supernova 27 times and counting is actually a hot, luminous, and decidedly unstable star that is being fed on by a vampiric black hole or neutron star, NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory has discovered. When a massive star reaches the end of the road and runs out of nuclear fuel to power fusion reactions in its core, the star is destroyed in a supernova explosion. That’s what astronomers thought they had found on 11 January 2012, when they observed what appeared to be a supernova on the outskirts of the spiral galaxy NGC 4559, which is about 25 million light-years away in the constellation Coma Berenices. Yet when the light of the 'supernova' faded, the star was still there, only to continue bursting into light every 113 days. "For 15 years, astronomers have been watching this star get really bright and then dim again on a regular basis," Mojgan Aghakhanloo of the University of Virginia in Charlottesville said in a statement . Several other supernova imposters have been observed over the past decade or two. Until now, no one knew what causes these stars to repeatedly cry wolf. Thanks to Chandra ’s X-ray vision, Aghakhanloo has led a team of astronomers who think they have now uncovered an explanation. How did a cosmic vampire hide as a supernova? The supernova imposter is named AT 2016blu, and is a type of star that we call a 'luminous blue variable,' or LBV. These are the most massive and luminous stars in the universe and their extreme characteristics result in them being highly unstable, undergoing intermittent bouts of mass loss as they eject material from their outer layers into the surrounding space. However, faking a supernova is not part of their typical behavior, so a new way of looking at AT 2016blu was needed. "To understand the cause of these eruptions, we realized that we needed X-ray data that was timed so that we’d observe the star when it was in an outburst," team member Núria Torres-Albà, also from the University of Virginia in Charlottesville, said. Aghakhanloo’s team were granted the opportunity to commandeer Chandra to target an outburst of AT 2016blu at the earliest opportunity. That opportunity arose in March 2026. A comparison between Chandra images from 2001–02 and 2026 at top, and optical light images at bottom, showing the supernova imposter outbursts and associated X-rays. (Image credit: X-ray: NASA/CXC/University of Virginia/M. Aghakhanloo et al; Optical: NSF/KAIT.) Chandra had previously and coincidentally looked in the direction of NGC 4559 back in 2001 and 2002 and did not notice anything unusual back then. This time around, however, it captured a powerful blast of X-rays coinciding with yet another false supernova outburst. The X-ray detection allowed Aghakhanloo’s team to assemble a picture of what is happening. item.title: Here are the 25 original Xbox games you can now play on PC
item.description: The first 25 original Xbox on PC games. | Image: Microsoft For the 25th anniversary of Xbox , Microsoft is beginning to make good on its paid "next-gen game preservation" promise. Starting today, you can play 25 different original Xbox games on your Windows PC, as long as you have (or are willing to pay) for digital copies. In July, Microsoft originally launched the idea with just four Xbox games , so 25 is progress, and Microsoft says all these games are now playable with keyboard and mouse. Plus, Microsoft says it's adding achievements to original Xbox games for the first time, starting with four games: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic and its sequel, Blinx: The Time Sweeper , and Conker: Li … Read the full story at The Verge.

item.title: My Ambition Is To Ensure Tinubu’s 2027 Victory, Says Matawalle
item.description: The Minister of State for Defence, Bello Matawalle, says his major ambition is to ensure the re-election of President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 general elections. Matawalle made this known while addressing supporters of the All Progressives Congress (APC) at his residence in Gusau, Zamfara State, ahead of the expected visit of the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu. He urged party members to unite and intensify mobilisation for Tinubu’s re-election, as well as the victory of other APC candidates in the state. The minister commended Tinubu’s efforts in tackling insecurity, developing infrastructure and promoting political cohesion, expressing his commitment to ensuring that the President completes his eight-year tenure. Matawalle said that after discharging his responsibilities as Minister of State for Defence, particularly in the fight against insecurity, his next major priority would be to work towards Tinubu’s re-election. He also dismissed what he described as provocations and propaganda by individuals seeking to tarnish his image, insisting that his priority was to sustain unity within the APC in Zamfara and secure victories for the party at all levels. The minister further dismissed allegations and propaganda concerning Tinubu’s health, maintaining that the President was fit to continue providing leadership and direction for the country. On security, Matawalle assured Zamfara residents that the Federal Government would deploy additional security personnel along major highways to protect commuters from persistent bandit attacks. He specifically mentioned the Talata Mafara-Gusau-Sokoto highway, as well as the Gummi-Anka-Bukkuyum and Tsafe access roads, as routes that would receive increased security attention. “We will deploy security forces along the Talata Mafara-Gusau-Sokoto highway to ensure the safe movement of commuters. We will also deploy security personnel to ensure the safety of those travelling along the Gummi, Anka, Bukkuyum and Tsafe roads,” he said. Matawalle pledged to do everything within his capacity to address insecurity in Zamfara and other parts of the country. He also spoke on the controversy surrounding the rerun election in Zamfara North Senatorial District, dismissing allegations of attempts to undermine his political standing and create divisions within the APC. The minister questioned the rationale behind the violence reportedly recorded during the rerun elections in Kaura Namoda and Birnin Magaji, insisting that political disagreements should not lead to attacks or destruction. “Those who caused the crisis during the rerun elections in Kaura Namoda and Birnin Magaji know whether they can emerge victorious or not. If victory is on your side, what is the essence of creating a crisis? We will not fight or attack anybody,” he said. item.title: Dejounte Murray fires back at ‘social media coach’ with NSFW rant
item.description: © Dennis Lee-Imagn Images Dejounte Murray fires back at ‘social media coach’ with NSFW rant appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Following the New Orleans Pelicans disappointing 145-111 loss to the Brooklyn Nets on Wednesday, Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray turned a few heads with a since-deleted social media post. Murray took offense to someone posting the team’s record with and without him in the lineup, leading him to suggest internal sabotage. And with Pelicans fans jumping on the narrative, Murray continued his social media crusade. The latest social media incident with Dejounte Murray occurred Thursday morning when a Pelicans fan fired back at Murray’s suggestion that someone in the organization was sabotaging him by showing unflattering clips of Murray’s play on the court. That was when the 10-year veteran jumped in with an NSFW rant. “Ohhhhh let’s talk about it. When you run post plays, are they supposed to catch on the block or the 3pt line? Let’s hear it Mr social media coach, Gm and president? You have no f**king clue what we dealing with,” Murray wrote. “Maybe you should ask the whole team individually how they feel on a serious note and then pull rethink a lot of s**t. You’ll be embarrassed to be a fan of this s**t IF YOU KNEW WHY I’m saying scapegoat or sabotage based off what’s going on real talk!!!’ Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Needless to say, the vibes around the Pelicans don’t appear to be very high at the moment . After the loss to the Nets, the team fell to 4-8 on the season and their current losing streak reached four games. The post that started the whole Murray ordeal pointed out that the Pelicans are 3-0 without him in the lineup this season and only 1-8 with him. On the season, he’s averaging 13.4 points, 4.6 rebounds, 4.4 assists and 1.6 steals with splits of 43.1 percent shooting from the field, 29.6 percent shooting from the 3-point line and 92.6 percent shooting from the free-throw line. Related: Nets nearly break multiple franchise records while demolishing Pelicans Related: Zion Williamson lays into Pelicans after worst 3-game stretch in franchise history

item.title: Oregon QB Dante Moore ruled out for rest of 2026 season
item.description: Oregon Ducks quarterback Dante Moore will miss the rest of the season, coach Dan Lanning announced Monday night. “I’m not anticipating him being back this season,” Lanning said. “Really got clarity for us this past week, for him,” Lanning added. “And I think if it were up to Dante in any shape, way, he would want to be out there playing for the guys. But, unfortunately, it’s not really up to Dante. It’s not really up to me. We can control the setting and practice where he’s able to do things for us, but that’s not always the case in the game.” Lanning said he expects Moore, who has run scout-team offense in practice, to fully recover. “That hasn’t changed,” Lanning said. “Definitely feel that way, but for him to be out there on the field for us right now, that’s not gonna happen.” Lanning added that Moore would remain involved with the team. “He’s still going to be a big part of this team and helping us move forward and find opportunities for us to be better,” Lanning said. Watch " Oregon Ducks QB Dante Moore to miss remainder of 2026 season " on YouTube Watch The announcement comes days after the reeling Ducks lost 21-10 at Illinois on Saturday in the third straight game Moore missed while in concussion protocol. Before the Illinois game, Moore told The Oregonian/OregonLive that he felt good but didn’t know if he’d return this season and was taking it “one day at a time.” “That’s all I can do,” he said. He then began throwing passes on the field in shorts and a sweatshirt. Saturday’s loss all but knocked Oregon (4-3, 2-2 Big Ten) out of the national playoff picture and led Lanning to fire offensive coordinator Drew Mehringer on Sunday. Without Moore, Oregon scored 42 points over three games and lost twice while rotating between backup quarterbacks Dylan Raiola and Brock Thomas. Moore was injured on Sept. 26 at USC while sliding to end a 10-yard run to the USC 13-yard line. As Moore began to slide, Trojans linebacker Desman Stephens II hit him in the head with his shoulder. Oregon quarterback Dante Moore, center bottom, takes a hard tackle by lSouthern California inebacker Desman Stephens II, center top, during the first half of an NCAA college football game, Saturday, Sept. 26, 2026, in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Mark J. Terrill) AP Photo/Mark J. Terrill Moore was taken off the field in a cart and loaded into an ambulance. Following Moore’s injury, Raiola entered the game and led the Ducks to a 41-27 win. Moore entered the concussion protocol but returned to practice the following bye week. Speculation was that Moore would return once he cleared the protocols. But each subsequent availability report listed Moore as out. On Oct. 10, Oregon lost 17-15 to UCLA, with Raiola struggling through three quarters before being replaced in the fourth quarter by Thomas. item.title: Reeling Oregon Ducks remain positive, committed to the grind
item.description: EUGENE — The 2026 season is on the verge of completely unraveling for the Oregon Ducks . One more loss, and any shred of postseason hopes would be extinguished. Yet even after two upset losses and falling out of the rankings — despite starting the season at No. 2 — the Ducks (3-2, 1-1 Big Ten) remain focused, together and committed to salvaging the season. “One thing I really love is the way the people in the locker room have been responding to this adversity,” sophomore cornerback Brandon Finney Jr. said. After his team’s 17-15 loss to No. 12 UCLA on Saturday, Oregon coach Dan Lanning said the team would be measured by how it responds moving forward. On Wednesday, he said the team has elevated its work ethic and embraced accountability. “I’ve been proud of the way that they’ve worked,” Lanning said. “I don’t see a lot of hanging heads, right? I think that’s challenging, too, especially when you’re young, to not lose a little bit of gusto and not lose a little bit of belief.” Oregon linebacker Devon Jackson (#9) drops UCLA running back Wayne Knight (#3) for no gain as the No. 13 Ducks face the No. 21 Bruins in a Big Ten college football game at Autzen Stadium in Eugene on Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026. Sean Meagher/The Oregonian The Ducks, who host Nebraska (5-1, 2-1) at 8 p.m. Saturday, responded well to adversity following a 39-31 loss at Oklahoma State on Sept. 12. Oregon won its next two games, including a 41-27 win at USC on Sept. 26. That victory seemed to give the Ducks a fresh start. But two weeks later, they lost to the Bruins and dropped out of the rankings. Now, Oregon must run the table to have a legitimate shot at the College Football Playoff, which seemed like a given for a team that returned most of its starters from last year’s semifinal squad. RELATED : Can the Ducks bounce back from UCLA loss? Experts release new Oregon vs. Nebraska predictions It’s not uncommon for teams with grand expectations to unravel in tough times. So far, that hasn’t happened. “The team is very connected and maintains its composure whether we’re winning or losing,” punter Bailey Ettridge said. “We haven’t let the losses last week and against Oklahoma State bring us down. I think we’ve handled them well.” Wide receiver Dakorien Moore said the team is filled with players who came to Oregon to win and be great. He added that the team’s goals remain attainable, and team leaders have worked to encourage togetherness and mutual trust. “If you can’t trust your teammate, then everything ain’t going to form in the way that it’s supposed to,” he said. This also means trusting the process, the plan and the team’s goal to get better instead of blaming one another. Oregon head coach Dan Lanning talks to the defense during a timeout as the No. 13 Oregon Ducks face the No. 21 UCLA Bruins in a Big Ten college football game at Autzen Stadium in Eugene on Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026. item.title: Oregon has 3 quarterbacks who could start Saturday. Illinois has a freshman who's never started before
item.description: The Oregon Ducks will face a team on Saturday with an even less desirable quarterback situation. Illinois (3-3, 1-2 Big Ten) quarterback Katin Houser suffered a broken hand that will sideline him for four to six weeks during a 38-37 overtime win over Michigan State on Oct. 10. Oregon has played its last two games without starting quarterback Dante Moore, who suffered a concussion in the second quarter of the Ducks’ 41-27 win at USC on Sept. 26. However, while Oregon can turn to junior Dylan Raiola — a Nebraska transfer with 23 career starts — and senior Brock Thomas, Illinois is relying on freshman quarterback Michael Clayton II, who will make his first start against the Ducks. A positive for Illinois is that Houser was injured before the team’s bye week, giving coach Bret Bielema two weeks to prepare Clayton. “It was just good timing,” Bielema told reporters during his Monday media session. Illinois is off to a disappointing start after going 9-4 in 2025 and 10-3 in 2024. The defense is below average, while the passing combination of Houser and wide receiver Collin Dixon is one of the nation’s best. Dixon is tied for third nationally with nine touchdown receptions. Illinois head coach Bret Bielema celebrates their overtime win over Michigan State as he walks off the field after an NCAA college football game, Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026, in East Lansing, Mich. (AP Photo/Lon Horwedel) AP Photo/Lon Horwedel AP Photo/Lon Horwedel Now Illinois heads into Saturday’s game against a resurgent Oregon defense, trying to get Clayton up to speed. His performance against MSU elevated expectations. Houser left the game late in the third quarter with Illinois leading 23-10. Clayton completed 6 of 8 passes for 88 yards and two touchdowns. The final touchdown came in overtime on a 25-yard pass that put Illinois up 38-31. Sophomore quarterback Carson Boyd also played. He rushed once for seven yards but did not attempt a pass. Bielema and offensive coordinator Barry Lunney Jr. both said Boyd could play against Oregon (4-2, 2-1), but Clayton is the starter. Usually, Bielema said, his starting quarterback gets a lot of rest during the bye week while the staff works on player development. Given Clayton and Boyd’s inexperience, both got valuable reps in practice last week. “I think those two guys in particular took advantage of every rep,” Bielema said. Bielema has leaned heavily on transfer quarterbacks during his six years at Illinois, including Houser. But that could change if Clayton, a former three-star recruit, earns the job. “I’ve said several times that hopefully the next starter comes from within our program,” Bielema said. Lunney said Clayton will be more prepared than he has in the past given the circumstances. Michigan State Spartans defensive back Charles Brantley (4) tackles Illinois Fighting Illini wide receiver Collin Dixon (17) in a Big 10 football game at Spartan Stadium in East Lansing, Mich. on Saturday, October 10, 2026. item.title: 10 takeaways from Oregon’s loss at Illinois and firing of OC Drew Mehringer
item.description: CHAMPAIGN, Ill. — The Oregon Ducks (4-3, 2-2 Big Ten) suffered their worst loss of the season at Illinois on Saturday . The 21-10 defeat came against a marginal Illinois team that started a true freshman at quarterback, rushed for 225 yards, and held Oregon to two scoring drives. As a result, on Sunday, Oregon coach Dan Lanning announced the firing of offensive coordinator Drew Mehringer . What that means for the rest of the season remains to be seen. Mehringer had to contend with several key personnel issues, including starting quarterback Dante Moore missing three games while in concussion protocol. Here are 10 takeaways from Saturday’s game and the firing of Mehringer: 1. It feels like Mehringer is the scapegoat in this mess Criticizing play-calling is an armchair quarterback’s delight, but doing so under Oregon’s current circumstances is somewhat obtuse. Few teams excel without their starting quarterback. The next factor is an offensive line that was clearly mismanaged in the offseason after losing three starters to the NFL. Next is inconsistent play from backup quarterbacks Dylan Raiola and Brock Thomas. Then sprinkle in losing top wideout Jeremiah McClellan (broken foot) after three games, starting wide receiver Evan Stewart (undisclosed injury) for the last two games, and two more rotational wide receivers heading into Illinois. Does all of that excuse Mehringer for Oregon scoring just 42 points over the past three weeks? No. But those are a lot of obstacles for any offensive coordinator to overcome. Watch " Oregon football fires offensive coordinator Drew Mehringer " on YouTube Watch 2. Where does Lanning go from here? Lanning will probably announce his new offensive coordinator during his Monday press conference. He could promote from within to get through the season and then conduct a national search in the offseason. Or he may have someone in mind to take over now and beyond. Whatever Lanning decides, the next play-caller had better hope Moore returns, or little will change. 3. It could be time to add a veteran coach to the staff Lanning did well by hiring younger offensive coordinators, Kenny Dillingham and then Will Stein. But maybe it’s time to bring in an accomplished, seasoned veteran coach to add a new perspective to a relatively young staff. Someone with a track record of success as an offensive coordinator and maybe as a head coach. Someone like former Oregon coach Chip Kelly, Northwestern’s offensive coordinator. No, don’t expect Kelly to want to return to Oregon. But someone like him could fit perfectly. 4. The wide receiver situation After Saturday’s game, Raiola was asked twice how difficult it was to build timing with the receiving crew, which lacked McClellan, Stewart, and freshmen Messiah Hampton and Jalen Lott. item.title: Dame Time is back in Portland — and the Blazers look dangerous
item.description: A new head coach will roam the sidelines. A franchise icon will make his long-awaited return. An All-Star will begin his redemption tour. And a new ownership group will watch its first season opener from Paul Allen’s former seats along the Moda Center baseline. The Blazers open the 2026-27 NBA season Wednesday night against the Phoenix Suns — a team they upset in April in the play-in tournament — and if you’re just now tuning in for the start of the regular season, well, there’s a lot you missed. RELATED: Suns vs. Blazers predictions, odds and best bets: Dame is home, and the model likes Portland on opening night Let’s catch you up. What does the starting lineup look like? The Blazers are expected to unveil a new starting lineup that features a pair of notable All-Star additions: Damian Lillard and Ja Morant . The backcourt duo is joining a fivesome that includes returning starters Deni Avdija , Toumani Camara and Donovan Clingan . It’s a versatile, star-studded lineup that features three All-Stars, a former All-Defensive Second Team selection, one of the best young centers in the NBA and loads of scoring potential. What about the rotation? Micah Nori , the Blazers’ first-year head coach, said he plans on using a 10-man rotation to start the season, which will allow the Blazers to capitalize on their depth and versatility. In addition to the starters, Jrue Holiday, Scoot Henderson, Sidy Cissoko, Robert Williams III and Vit Krejci are expected to open the season in the rotation. The group could change depending on matchups and Williams’ availability — he did not play in back-to-backs last season — and it’s likely that Micah Potter, Branden Carlson and Yang Hansen will occasionally see spot duty, as well. Wait … the Blazers have a new coach? The Blazers stabilized their turbulent coaching situation in June, hiring longtime NBA assistant Nori to replace interim coach Tiago Splitter . Nori, who interviewed for head coaching jobs seven times before finally landing his first chance, is entering his 29th season in the league and is universally revered in NBA circles for his positive approach, ability to connect with players and sharp basketball mind. Early indications have been encouraging, as the Blazers players seem to love him and the front office works well with him. The Blazers’ coaching position had been embroiled in controversy, of course, as former coach Chauncey Billups — who was placed on indefinite leave by the NBA — is facing federal felony charges related to money laundering and wire fraud conspiracy for his alleged involvement in a rigged underground poker game. What style will the Blazers play? In a stark contrast to recent seasons, the Blazers are constructed around their offense rather than their defense. The roster is unbalanced, featuring five dynamic ball-handlers and playmakers (Lillard, Morant, Avdija, Holiday and Henderson), a solid center combination (Clingan and Williams) and little wing depth. item.title: OSU's Legree leads nation in receiving as WSU clash looms
item.description: CORVALLIS — There may be no more appropriate way to describe Oregon State’s outrageously successful passing game this season than explosive. The Beavers lead the country in passing yards thanks in large part to 10 passes of 40-plus yards. Jesse Legree is responsible for eight of those catches, including all five of OSU’s 50-yard pass plays this season, making it no surprise that he leads the country in receiving yards and touchdowns entering this week’s matchup with Washington State. “You see him with ball in space, obviously taking the top off a number of times,” Washington State coach Kirby Moore said. “I think it’s about playing team defense. Obviously communication is going to be really important, where he’s at.” The Cougars (1-5, 0-2 Pac-12) have the No. 2 defense in the Pac-12 thus far and are having that success by keeping the top on their pass coverage. WSU has allowed 11 passes of 30-plus yards, which is tied for 129th nationally and nearly 10% of the passes it has allowed. However, opponents are not breaking through that mark often, with just four passes over 40 yards and none for more than 50, one of 30 teams yet to allow such a play this season. “We don’t want to let the verticals up,” Washington State safety Jaylen Smith said. “We take pride in (not) letting deep balls go. We always look to play top down and take away the deep routes first.” WSU defensive coordinator Trent Bray will be tasked with doing what nobody has been able to do yet this season: contain Legree. OSU offensive coordinator Mitch Dahlen has been creative in moving Legree around to prevent defenses from taking him away. Last week against San Diego State that included moving Legree into the backfield for a variety of plays. “People are going to try and hit him at the line of scrimmage,” Dahlen said. “They’re going to try and two-hand jam. If they’re going to try and two-hand jam, it’s like OK, how can I move this guy enough where you can’t do that? You put him in the backfield, unless you want to jump offsides and do it, you can’t do it that way. “That’s what we do a good job of as a staff, is moving him around where you can’t just put a safety over the top of him because if he’s in the backfield, what are you going to do there?” Even if the Cougars manage to limit Legree, the Beavers have shown they are more than capable of going elsewhere, with an outrageous 14 players catching passes last week. Aeryn Hampton (20 receptions for 245 yards) and tight ends Eric Olsen and DeCorion Temple each have at least 20 catches and Aaron Butler has four grabs for at least 20 yards. They’re confident they can challenge any defense vertically. “The underneath throws are going to be there,” Hampton said. “We got the best OC in the country; we’re going to be able to go deep if we want to.” Latest Beavers news Oregon State QB Braden Atkinson going through further testing of hand injury before Boise State game Oregon State basketball lands 3-star center for 2027 class Oregon State wome

item.title: Stephen A. Smith visits White House again after controversial dinner with President Trump
item.description: USA TODAY Sports via Reuters Connect Last month, Stephen A. Smith met with United States President Donald Trump for what turned out to be a high-profile and controversial dinner. On Thursday, the ESPN star was back at the White House. Smith’s last visit, a dinner alongside Bill Maher and Kid Rock, drew plenty of backlash and ended with Trump publicly trashing the evening as a “waste of time.” But that did not seem to stop Smith from visiting again this week. Dinner With Trump Back in October, Trump had a high-profile dinner with Smith, Maher, and Kid Rock where the four discussed a number of topics for hours. Kid Rock was the first to share details about the dinner , saying the group discussed everything from the war in Iran to socialism. Smith said he went to advocate for HBCU funding. “Anytime I see HBCUs in trouble, I’m going to do what I can to help,” Smith said, via The Comeback . “It’s just that simple.” Smith said the dinner lasted more than four hours, and he compared Trump to legendary boxing promoter Don King. Trump, however, later disputed Smith’s account in a lengthy social media post. “I learned nothing, and felt it was a waste of time,” Trump wrote. “It didn’t last four hours, it lasted two hours, maybe less.” Trump also called Maher a “COMPLETE AND TOTAL LOSER” and a “major POTHEAD” in the same post. Back at the White House While Trump may have dismissed the meeting as a waste of time, that does not seem to have scared Smith away. On Thursday, CBS News shared video of Smith arriving at the White House. The network noted that Smith “was seen walking into the West Wing.” The White House has not said why Smith was there. Smith has not yet commented on the visit. Given how much Smith had to say about his last trip to the White House, though, he probably won’t stay quiet about this one for long. Stephen A.’s Political Ambitions Smith has repeatedly floated the idea of running for president in 2028 as a Democrat. But he hasn’t always made it easy to tell where he stands politically, often taking shots at both parties. He has called out Trump for making “utterly ridiculous” promises, and said Republicans had “no spine whatsoever” against the president. But he also recently praised Secretary of State Marco Rubio as “the real deal” and predicted he will be the Republican nominee in 2028. Smith added that he hasn’t seen a Democrat who can beat him yet. Smith’s political future may face an uphill battle regardless. A recent poll showed that neither side of the aisle is particularly fond of him. The post Stephen A. Smith visits White House again after controversial dinner with President Trump appeared first on The Comeback: Today’s Top Sports Stories & Reactions .

item.title: Klopp praises Kimmich, keeps starters for Serbia match under wraps
item.description: Germany coach Jürgen Klopp attends a press conference at Rajko Mitic Stadium, ahead of Friday's UEFA Nations League soccer match against Serbia. (is associated with: «Klopp praises Kimmich, keeps starters for Serbia match under wraps») Christian Charisius/dpa Jürgen Klopp, Germany's men's national football coach, already has his starting line-up in mind for the Nations League match against Serbia on Friday, but he's not talking. "If nothing happens overnight, I know how we will start," Klopp told reporters on Thursday ahead of the match, which starts at 8:45 pm (1945 GMT) at the Belgrade stadium. Klopp, 59, did not confirm the expected appearance of captain Joshua Kimmich. However, he lavished praise on the star player. "Jo Kimmich is a superplayer." Kimmich was not in the squad that beat Serbia 2-0 in the first leg in Munich. At that game, Kimmich's Bayern colleagues Aleksandar Pavlović and Tom Bischof put in top midfield performances alongside Florian Wirtz. Klopp called that game just a "blueprint" for him. The German coach had already committed to Marc-André ter Stegen as the number one goalkeeper when nominating the squad. He had also confirmed Bayern player Jonathan Tah in defence. Aim: a "final" against the Netherlands Klopp's immediate goal is to keep alive the German team's chances of reaching the Nations League quarter-finals with a second win against the winless Serbs. "We feel well prepared," Klopp said after four training sessions. He said everyone wants to earn "a final" for the last group game on Monday in Berlin against the Netherlands. Klopp said the fifth international match under his leadership was a test of how far the team has come. He regretted that only several thousand Serbian children will be admitted to the stadium because of a spectator ban.

item.title: Hawks’ CJ McCollum taking his talents to TV amid rough start to season
item.description: Jordan Godfree-Imagn Images Hawks’ CJ McCollum taking his talents to TV amid rough start to season appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Atlanta Hawks have had an up-and-down start to the season, currently sitting at 7-5 after a recent home loss to the Los Angeles Lakers. CJ McCollum has had a rough start to the year, not providing the kind of efficiency and half-court shot creation Atlanta was hoping for when they re-signed him this past offseason. Now, McCollum has agreed to embark on a new venture simultaneously with the Hawks’ season. “CJ McCollum, who you may know as a guard for the Atlanta Hawks, will be a part of Amazon’s NBA coverage this season. He’s going to be in studio at times during this season,” reported Mike Vorkunov of The Athletic on X, formerly Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) It’s unclear how often McCollum will appear as an analyst on the show, especially considering that Prime films its NBA studio coverage on location in Los Angeles, California, while McCollum plays on the opposite coast. It’s not exactly a common sight for an active professional athlete to simultaneously be an in-studio analyst. Draymond Green has spent time as an analyst for “Inside the NBA,” but that almost always occurs in situations in which the Golden State Warriors have already been eliminated from the playoffs. Meanwhile, Hawks fans are hoping that McCollum still makes time to practice his skills on the court, as he hasn’t brought the same level of shotmaking that he contributed in Atlanta’s solid showing in the first round against the New York Knicks this past spring. In any case, the Hawks are next set to take the floor on Friday evening for a road game against the Chicago Bulls. Tipoff is set for 8:00 pm ET.

item.title: Newark Catholic volleyball falls in Division VII state semifinal
item.description: Another championship season for the Newark Catholic volleyball team has come to an end. NC was unable to sustain a fast start Nov. 12 in a loss to Fort Loramie, 27-25, 25-18, 25-19, in a Division VII state semifinal at Wright State. The Green Wave (21-5) were reigning Division VI state champions and hoping stay on top but fell to Fort Loramie (23-4), the 2024 Division VII state champion. Leah Caudill recorded 15 kills in her final match for NC, which led 9-1 in the first set before Fort Loramie came charging back, eventually scoring six of the final seven points. Sophia Basham added 14 kills, Gabbie Hill 22 assists and Calla Whitlach 17 digs. This article originally appeared on Newark Advocate: Newark Catholic volleyball falls in Division VII state semifinal

item.title: Jets’ biggest mistake at 2026 NFL Trade Deadline
item.description: Image Credit: Denny Medley-Imagn Images Jets’ biggest mistake at 2026 NFL Trade Deadline appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The New York Jets ’ biggest mistake at the 2026 trade deadline was keeping Breece Hall . They had a rare chance to cash in at running back and instead protected a backfield that now works against its best young player, Braelon Allen. At 2-7, they were in a position to sell, and the one trade they made involved a backup safety. Quiet Deadline for a Losing Team The Jets’ only trade was sending safety Andre Cisco to Detroit for a 2028 sixth-round pick . Ian Rapoport reported edge rusher Will McDonald IV had asked to be traded, and Jets players on expiring deals drew interest. The Jets were only interested in moving expiring contracts, preferring to keep their 2027 roster intact. That approach is hard to defend for a team that is 5-21 in the Aaron Glenn era. A rebuilding club should be collecting assets, not protecting veterans who may not be part of the next good roster. The Jets did that last year when they traded Sauce Gardner and Quinnen Williams. This year, they stood pat. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Why Hall Was the Right Trade Chip John Jones-Imagn Images Hall was the most obvious candidate. Allen filled in during Hall’s five-game absence with a quad injury, rushing for 504 yards and two touchdowns in five starts. He had three 100-yard games in that stretch, and that 504 yards is more than Hall has gained in any five-game stretch of his career. The financial case was just as strong. Allen is on his rookie contract at roughly $1.2 million this season and $1.3 million in 2027. Hall signed a three-year extension in May worth $43.5 million. The Jets would have taken only a $5 million dead-cap hit in 2026 and $4 million in 2027 while gaining around $10 million in space. Hall was also due to return at a moment when contenders needed running backs. Trading him would have turned a surplus into picks and given Allen a clean path. Kansas City reportedly offered a third-round pick for Hall a year earlier, which shows the market exists. Allen’s Role Now Looks Muddled The Jets said they would not trade Hall, and they did not. Some outlets called that a smart way to keep depth. But the first game back suggests the split is hurting both players. In Week 9, Hall had 15 carries to Allen’s eight and out-targeted him 4-2. Allen still played more snaps, 36 to 27, and saw the only goal-line carry, which he did not convert. Allen finished with 33 yards on eight carries and lost a fumble in the 35-12 loss to Kansas City. The week before, he rushed 21 times for 147 yards and a touchdown against the Raiders. One of the league’s best rushing performances has been replaced by a confusing committee. Glenn declined to explain how carries would be distributed. The Jets can say they kept depth. But depth only matters if it helps win games, and the Jets are 2-7. A team with no playof

item.title: Robert Griffin III reveals stance on Nick Sirianni, Jalen Hurts’ Eagles futures
item.description: Denny Medley-Imagn Images Robert Griffin III reveals stance on Nick Sirianni, Jalen Hurts’ Eagles futures appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Philadelphia Eagles recently waved the white flag on the 2026 NFL season with a series of moves, headlined by their trade of Jordan Davis to the Jacksonville Jaguars in exchange for future draft compensation. The moves come amid the Eagles’ current seven-game losing streak, with the team falling apart at the seams, primarily due to injuries. Now, former NFL quarterback Robert Griffin III has taken to social media to reveal his take on the future of two key members of the Eagles. “The Eagles’ season is lost, but they shouldn’t fire Nick Sirianni or trade Jalen Hurts this offseason,” wrote Griffin III on X, formerly Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Sirianni has long been one of the most polarizing coaches in the NFL today. On the one hand, Philadelphia consistently has churned out winning seasons (this year aside) under his watch, and have also won a Super Bowl and appeared in another. On the other hand, the Eagles have had some clear signs of friction with Siriannia at the helm, including the coach himself shouting at the home fans and suffering some puzzling playoff losses and late-season meltdowns. Meanwhile, Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for the rest of this season due to a frightening blood clot situation. Prior to that point, Hurts was suffering through one of the worst seasons of his career, with the offense continuing to regress despite switching coordinators this past offseason. It remains to be seen if the Eagles will make any drastic moves this offseason after a failed 2026 campaign, but some fans have certainly made it known that they want changes at both the head coach and quarterback positions. Related: Eagles trade deadline grade after getting first round pick for Jordan Davis Related: Here’s how Bengals HC Zac Taylor responded to failing to complete trade with Eagles

item.title: Braves sign former Dodgers relief pitcher Evan Phillips to contract
item.description: Los Angeles Dodgers relief pitcher Evan Phillips celebrates after San Diego Padres' Wil Myers hit into a double play to end the top of the sixth inning in Game 1 of a baseball NL Division Series Tuesday, Oct. 11, 2022, in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Marcio Jose Sanchez) The Atlanta Braves made their first move of Major League Baseball’s Winter Meetings on Thursday morning by adding a relief pitcher. The team signed reliever Evan Phillips to a 3-year, $35 million contract, adding him to what could be one of baseball’s best bullpens. [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] The 32-year-old Phillips has been with Dodgers for the past 5 seasons. His 2026 season didn’t start until July after he recovered from Tommy John surgery in June of 2025. Phillips finished 2026 with a 3-2 record, a 3.46 ERA and 33 strikeouts. He pitched 5 times for the Dodgers during the playoffs and did not give up a single run. TRENDING STORIES: SEC Week 11: No. 1 Georgia hosts No. 22 Missouri while No. 8 Texas travels to No. 24 LSU 2031 FIFA Women’s World Cup: US joint bid lists Atlanta as host city Georgia Bulldogs move to the top of the College Football Playoff rankings Phillips, who hails from Clayton, NC, was originally drafted by the Braves in the 17th round of the 2015 draft. He made it to Atlanta during the 2018 season, pitching in 4 games before being traded to Baltimore. He pitched for Tampa Bay in 2021 before landing with the Dodgers. [SIGN UP: WSB-TV Daily Headlines Newsletter ] Phillips will team up with Robert Suarez, Dylan Lee and possibly Didier Fuentes to make a strong back end of the bullpen. Closer Raisel Iglesias is a free agent and it is not clear yet if he will return for another season.

item.title: Curt Cignetti has questions after Indiana’s updated rankings placement
item.description: Rich Janzaruk/Herald-Times / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images Curt Cignetti has questions after Indiana’s updated rankings placement appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . No. 9 Indiana football fell in the College Football Playoff rankings during its bye week. The Hoosiers dropped five spots to No. 9 despite not playing. That didn’t sit well with head coach Curt Cignetti , per On3Sports.com. Additionally, Cignetti made it clear on X, formerly Twitter: “Bad losses don’t count anymore? 😂😂😂😂😂😂 Are first downs still 10 yards?🤡🤡🤡” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Bad losses don't count anymore? 😂😂😂😂😂😂 Are first downs still 10 yards?🤡🤡🤡 — Curt Cignetti (@CCignettiIU) November 12, 2026 Indiana is 8-1 and is defending the national champions. item.title: Ferrari’s F1 Team Is Worth $8.2 Billion, and Even Last-Place Cadillac Is Worth $2.7B
item.description: Ferrari is worth $8.2 billion, the most of any F1 team for the fourth year in a row, and even Cadillac, the grid’s least valuable team, is worth $2.7 billion in its first season, according to Sportico ’s new team valuations. The average F1 team is now worth $4.55 billion. That’s up 33% on last year, or 39% if you leave out Cadillac, which joined in 2026 and pulls the average down. It follows a 48% rise last year, and the average has almost tripled since 2023. Sportico says no other major league comes close over that stretch. The next best are the NHL, up 85% since 2023, and the NFL, up 81%. Ferrari Tops the List for a Fourth Straight Year Liam Lawson leads Lando Norris and the field at the start of the F1 São Paulo GP. Image Credit: Manuel Eletto/Sutton Images via Getty Images/Red Bull Content Pool Ferrari’s value is up 28% on last year. Mercedes is second at $7.75 billion (up 32%), McLaren is third at $6.3 billion (up 33%) and Red Bull is fourth at $5.6 billion (up 30%). Aston Martin is fifth at $4.15 billion, up 38%, even though it’s 10th in the constructors’ standings. New York Jets owner Woody Johnson bought more than 15% of the team this summer at a value of about $4.7 billion, Sportico reported. Alpine is sixth at $3.28 billion (up 58%), and Williams is seventh at $3.24 billion (up 51%). Cadillac Is Worth $2.7 Billion in Its First Season Racing Bulls, on course for fifth in the constructors’ championship, is eighth at $3.05 billion (up 49%). Red Bull turned down a billion-dollar bid for the team. Audi is ninth at $3 billion (up 60%), and Haas, the other American-owned team, is 10th at $2.8 billion (up 67%). Cadillac is last at $2.7 billion, with no figure from last year because it only joined the grid in 2026. Its owners, TWG Global and General Motors, paid a $450 million fee to enter and put in at least another $1 billion to get the team running. TWG boss Mark Walter is now shopping his stake with an asking price of at least $3 billion. Together, the 11 teams are worth $50 billion. These are Sportico ‘s estimates rather than sale prices, built from its own sums and from interviews with team owners, executives, bankers, lawyers and investors. item.title: Kirk Herbstreit urges caution over strong reactions to CFP rankings
item.description: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images. Kirk Herbstreit urges caution over strong reactions to CFP rankings appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . As the College Football Playoff (CFP) rankings have been released and updated, there is no doubt that many in the sports world will have their own reactions, though Kirk Herbstreit takes a different approach. While the CFP rankings will always feature stunning drops and shocking rises, Herbstreit is confident that everything will fall into place over time. Speaking on “The Pat McAfee Show,” the self-titled host would ask the college football analyst about the latest CFP rankings on Thursday, asking if he’s surprised by any of the placements. Herbstreit would downplay it, saying that he’s “learned” not to get “alarmed” by the CFP rankings this early on. “I’ve learned over the years not to really get alarmed by these first two or three, four weeks of these rankings,” Herbstreit said. “When we were first going through it, especially when it was four teams, I think it was very obvious and easy to be like, ‘Oh my gosh, how is this team ranked here?’ And now I feel like, and it makes you wonder about what the future will be with 24. I just think that eventually it’ll work itself out.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) "I've learned over the years not to really get alarmed by these first two, or three, four weeks of these rankings." @KirkHerbstreit weighs in on the current CFP rankings 👀 pic.twitter.com/y7xkD5wI8N — ESPN College Football (@ESPNCFB) November 12, 2026 Kirk Herbstreit continues on the CFP rankings As some in the sports world were shocked to see teams like the Indiana football team down to No. 9 or the Miami Hurricanes drop to No. 7 after being at the very top, Herbstreit pays no mind. He does believe that controversy will come by the end, such as when Notre Dame was left out with the Alabama Crimson Tide going in. “Right now, there are people who are anti-SEC,” Herbstreit said. “No matter what they do, they’re up in arms that UCLA is undefeated, Alabama is ahead of them. You wonder with teams like Oregon, South Carolina, and USC, maybe even an LSU, go all the way down to 23. If some of these teams were to win out just because of who they’re playing and the opportunity to impress the committee, that could become something that becomes a sticky point.” It remains to be seen how the conversation will be surrounding the CFB rankings. Related: Florida Gators land massive commitment that quarterbacks will love Related: Wake Forest football’s Jake Dickert lands new contract extension amid 8-1 start to season

item.title: After World Cup experience, Leo Nannetti shares lessons with Brazil U20s
item.description: After World Cup experience, Leo Nannetti shares lessons with Brazil U20s Brazil’s youth national teams are the natural pathway to the senior side. Goalkeeper Leo Nannetti, however, landed a golden ticket and got a “sneak peek” at life with the Seleção during the 2026 World Cup, when he was invited to join the squad and had the privilege of training alongside his idols. Now he is putting that experience to work with the U-20s and sharing what he learned with his teammates. Nannetti’s first opportunity with Brazil came with the U-17 national team in 2024, when he played in the Cascais Luso Cup. In 2025, however, he skipped a step: he joined the senior squad for training at Granja Comary ahead of World Cup qualifiers against Chile and Bolivia. In 2026, the invitation was like a VIP pass: he attended the World Cup and trained alongside Alisson, Ederson and Weverton under Taffarel’s guidance, experiencing the tournament atmosphere firsthand. Leo Nannetti: U-17 call-ups and invitations to train with the senior national team already on his résumé, and now looking forward to a tournament with the U-20s Credits: Joilson Marconne / CBF “I never imagined I would be experiencing a World Cup atmosphere at 18. It added so much to my career and my personal life. I was alongside my idols, watching how they conduct themselves, how they train and how they prepare for each game. I’ll carry that experience with me for the rest of my life,” he said. Naturally, these experiences spark curiosity among his teammates, although most already play for their clubs’ senior teams. Nannetti shares what he can and draws on the experience he has gained throughout his career to keep improving with Brazil’s U-20s. The goalkeeper has been working hard in training in Belém ahead of two friendlies against Peru Credits: Joilson Marconne / CBF “A lot of them ask what it was like, and I always try to answer as naturally as possible. The technical and mental demands change a lot from one national team to the next. The U-17s are more about development, the U-20s are very competitive, and the senior team—well, that goes without saying, doesn’t it? The pressure they carry, representing an entire nation,” he said. The goalkeeper considers one thing essential: keeping each of these experiences in perspective so he can continue developing. “I always try to keep my feet on the ground. If I’m here today, I have God, coach Paulo Victor and the coaching staff to thank for believing in my work. And I have to remember that being called up now doesn’t mean I’ll be at the South American Championship. It’s an important step, but I give my best in every training session to try to secure my place in the squad,” he concluded. This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence. You can read the original version in 🇧🇷 here.

item.title: Predators’ Nils Hoglander scores potential goal-of-year candidate vs. Ducks
item.description: Gary A. Vasquez-Imagn Images Predators’ Nils Hoglander scores potential goal-of-year candidate vs. Ducks appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Nashville Predators have been on fire as of late. They have won six straight games, including a win on the road for the Predators over the Colorado Avalanche , on November 5. On Wednesday night, the Predators took the 4-2 victory. In the second period, Nils Hoglander scored a goal that made it 2-1. It is also a potential goal of the year candidate , according to Anna Kulesa of NHL.com. BETWEEN-THE-LEGS, TOP SHELF HÖGGY 🤯 pic.twitter.com/XNHfC9kYxt Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) — Nashville Predators (@PredsNHL) November 12, 2026 With four minutes left in the second period, Shane Wright played a puck off the boards, which found Jayden Struble in the center of the ice. He found Hoglander in front of the net. He pulled the puck between his legs on his backhand, then quickly moved to his forehand and found the top shelf, beating Laurent Brossoit for the goal. Hoglander also added an assist in the game, giving him two points. It was his second straight multi-point game, after having two assists against the Los Angeles Kings on Tuesday night. This year, he has four goals and five assists in 19 games. Hoglander is in his first season with the Predators. He was the 40th overall selection of the 2019 NHL Draft by the Vancouver Canucks. He broke into the league during the 2020-21 season, playing 56 games with the Canucks that season. He played 331 games with the Canucks, scoring 60 goals and adding 60 assists. This past offseason, Hoglander was traded to the Predators for a 2029 third-round pick. The Predators will look to keep their winning streak going on Friday night. They will visit the Vegas Golden Knights, with puck drop set for 10 pm ET.

item.title: NHL rumors: Insider floats Jason Robertson-Nikita Kucherov blockbuster trade
item.description: Kim Klement Neitzel-Imagn Images NHL rumors: Insider floats Jason Robertson-Nikita Kucherov blockbuster trade appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Neither Nikita Kucherov nor Jason Robertson is under contract beyond the 2026-27 season. With Kucherov having requested a trade and the Dallas Stars expected to revisit extension talks with Robertson in December, Daily Faceoff’s Matt Larkin floated a hypothetical blockbuster : the Tampa Bay Lightning and Stars swapping their star forwards one for one. “It’s difficult to imagine (Robertson) and the Stars getting in bed together long-term after such contentious negotiations,” Larkin wrote in his latest NHL Trade Board. “But they need him this season; it only makes sense to trade him if it’s in a hockey deal that helps them now. “How about Kucherov, one for one?” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Lightning general manager Julien BriseBois has said he doesn’t intend to trade Kucherov, but keeping him without an extension risks losing him for nothing next summer. Kucherov has been on a tear since his trade request, amassing 11 points in six games. He’s certainly not quiet quitting on the team where he won two Stanley Cups, but his future in Tampa remains in doubt. “As much as Kucherov and his camp might feel content to play out the season in Tampa, it remains to be seen if it will make things uncomfortable in the room, and it won’t stop suitors from coming forward with offers,” Larkin added. “That’s why Kucherov lands in tier 1 of this list. It’s tough to imagine this saga dragging all the way to July 1, even if his camp is fine with that happening.” Kucherov continues to be one of the NHL’s best players, now at 26 points in 18 games, while Robertson is off to another great start for the Stars, with nine goals and 19 points of his own in 17 games. Robertson’s name has been swirling in trade rumors for over a year. He reportedly turned down an eight-year offer worth about $15 million annually from the Seattle Kraken in a proposed sign-and-trade. He ended up inking a one-year, $12 million pact with Dallas to avoid arbitration, but his future remains up in the air. Both Dallas and Tampa Bay remain Stanley Cup contenders, so any deal would have to help them win now. A one-for-one swap seems unlikely, but crazier things have happened in the NHL. Related: Best Matvei Michkov landing spots amid growing trade buzz

item.title: Real Madrid could activate buyback clause before selling defender to Premier League
item.description: Real Madrid could activate buyback clause before selling defender to Premier League The board at La Liga giants Real Madrid are weighing up a number of options when it comes to the future of Como star Jacobo Ramón. Youngster Jacobo for his part departed Real Madrid on a permanent basis in the summer of 2025. After making the call to seek out more consistent senior playing time in Italy, the 21-year-old has since gone on to emerge as a leading figure at Cesc Fàbregas’ Como. After racking up 30 Serie A starts last season, Jacobo has since followed up with a further 13 starts between league and European competition this time round. And along the way, the Spaniard has excelled at both ends of the pitch, already with three goals and two assists to his name. Unfortunately for Como, though, with such ongoing excellence comes inevitable outside interest. A number of the Premier League’s leading clubs are understood to have set their sights on Jacobo’s services for next season. Not only that, but Real Madrid maintain a buyback clause. And as alluded to above, this week, an insight into just how Los Blancos could make use of as much has been provided. As per a report from ESPN : ‘Real Madrid have very positive reports on Jacobo Ramón’s progress, to the point that some sources admit that the logical situation is for the centre-back to be bought back next summer. However, the same sources explain that it is still too early to know the final decision, and the option of buying him back and then selling him to another team is not ruled out.’ Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: NFL analyst picks Bears’ Caleb Williams over NFC North rivals for playoff run
item.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has earned another vote of confidence ahead of the next NFL playoff race. ESPN analyst Evan Cohen picked Williams over his NFC North rivals when asked which quarterback he trusted most in a postseason situation. Speaking on ESPN’s First Take, Shae Cornette asked Cohen which division quarterback he would trust in a playoff game. Cohen chose Williams despite acknowledging the experience and recent form of his competition. “I’m going to answer it. The answer is Caleb Williams,” Cohen said. “Even though Jared Goff is the one who’s been there and done that.” MORE: Giants’ J.J. McCarthy shares honest reaction to Kirk Cousins’ Vikings return Cohen also praised Jordan Love, noting that the Packers quarterback was “probably playing better than anyone else right now.” He also mentioned Kirk Cousins, saying, “a quarterback that is unbelievably experienced.” His choice stands out because Chicago faces strong competition from Detroit’s Jared Goff and Green Bay’s Jordan Love. Both quarterbacks have delivered more consistent production this season. Goff has completed 67.8% of his passes for 2,134 yards, 15 touchdowns and two interceptions. Love leads the division with 2,618 passing yards and 19 touchdowns. Williams has completed 68.7% of his passes for 1,546 yards, eight touchdowns and five interceptions. He has also added 145 rushing yards and two scores across six games. Caleb Williams has earned trust despite mistakes Chicago, Illinois, USA; Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams (18) reacts after the game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Soldier Field. Mandatory Credit: Talia Sprague-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Despite the Bears quarterback’s struggles, Cohen sees something different in Williams. “I just think Caleb Williams has got that effect,” he explained. “And I believe in his coach and his connection with his coach. I also believe that there’s a guy with big orange sleeves on defense and Jeffrey Simmons that is going to make Caleb Williams’ life easier by being so great on defense.” Cohen’s confidence comes despite Williams’ turnover problems during Chicago’s recent playoff run. The quarterback threw two interceptions against Green Bay before delivering a dramatic comeback victory. He completed 24 of 48 passes for 361 yards and two touchdowns in the 31-27 Wild Card win. Williams also helped Chicago force overtime against the Rams, throwing a late touchdown to Cole Kmet. However, three interceptions contributed to the Bears’ 20-17 defeat. Recently, Williams committed four interceptions in a 27-24 win over Tampa Bay. Still, Cohen viewed his resilience as a positive. “I will trust Caleb Williams in a big spot. And yes, we’re coming off of a four-turnover game for him, five for the team, but that actually makes me more impressed. They still won,” he said, referring to the game. "The answer is Caleb Williams. … Caleb Williams has got that 'IT' factor." @EvCoRadio weighs in on

item.title: Folarin Balogun and Sebastian Berhalter speak out on Mauricio Pochettino’s USMNT impact and future
item.description: Folarin Balogun and Sebastian Berhalter spoke with reporters about head coach Mauricio Pochettino on Thursday -Credit:Cory Knowlton/ISI Photos/ISI Photos via Getty Images As things stand, it is widely expected that after little more than two years in charge of the U.S. Men’s National Team, head coach Mauricio Pochettino is set to move back to the Premier League to take charge of a wayward Manchester United. While neither U.S. Soccer, United, nor Pochettino have yet confirmed this, it is believed that the 54-year-old will remain with the USMNT for the duration of their ongoing camp , including their two upcoming CONCACAF Nations League quarter-final games against Haiti, before jetting off to Manchester. And while the U.S. players are fully aware of what is being reported, it appears that they are equally unaware of whether or not Pochettino’s time in charge is coming to a swift end for certain. Balogun confirmed that the players have yet to find out if Pochettino's supposedly impending move to Manchester United is a sure thing -Credit:Alex Livesey - FIFA/FIFA via Getty Images Speaking with reporters on Thursday, striker Folarin Balogun said, “Obviously, we see everything that's being written online as something we can't avoid as players. “But, me speaking personally, I don't know if it's true, if it's not, if it's confirmed. My only focus is just to come into practice and prepare for the games. And I'm sure if it is something that does become official, he'll let us know as soon as possible.” This sentiment was echoed by midfielder Sebastian Berhalter, son of Pochettino’s predecessor Gregg, who commented, “We're focused on going against Haiti twice. They're a good team. And I think you saw that World Cup. They surprised people. So that's our main focus. And yeah, I think the group is ready to play these games.” Should this camp prove Pochettino’s last with the USMNT, despite having signed a four-year deal following this past summer’s FIFA World Cup where they were knocked out by Belgium in the Round of 16, the impact the former Tottenham Hotspur boss has had will seemingly stick around. “Personally, on the field and off the field, he's done a lot for me,” Berhalter said. “And, I think from day one, he's always believed in me before I set foot on the field. item.title: ‘I Still Talk to Him’: Aaron Rodgers Looks Forward to Reuniting with Mike Tomlin on Sunday Night
item.description: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers and head coach Mike Tomlin after the Steelers' 34-32 win over the New York Jets on Sept. 7, 2025. -- Ed Thompson / Steelers Now PITTSBURGH — Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers has tuned in to watch Mike Tomlin on NBC’s Football Night in America this season. He thinks his former head coach is a natural as an analyst. “I’m not surprised in the least,” Rodgers said of Tomlin turning heads in his new role. “He is absolutely killing it on TV the few times I’ve seen him. Nobody can talk football better than Mike T, so it is an absolute match made in heaven. Him being on TV and doing what he does. And I don’t know if he still wants to coach at some point, but he’s doing a hell of a job.” Tomlin will see his former team up close and in person for the first time on Sunday night since resigning in January. “I look forward to it because of the relationships, but you know me, I’m capable of compartmentalizing, and getting hyper-focused on the job,” Tomlin said on a conference call with NBC Sports on Wednesday. “But it certainly will be fun to see some guys I got relationships with and there’ll certainly be a lot of those. But they have a job to do, I have a job to do, and so I’m sure everyone’s going to be focused on the task at hand.” Rodgers still keeps in touch with Tomlin. “I still talk to him,” Rodgers said. “I love Mike T, and I have so much appreciation for him bringing me here last year and the amount of fun that we had together. The closeness of the bond that we formed. So it’ll be good to see him.” “I’m having a lot of fun,” Tomlin said. “Haven’t given one iota of thought about coaching. I’m sure that some of that’s going to come up in the not-too-distant future. But I’ll cross that bridge when I come to it. Really haven’t thought a lot about it. Really excited about my new role and working to get better each and every week.” Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy has never seen Tomlin smile more than he is right now. “I’m really happy for Mike. I’m trying not to laugh because I’ve never seen him smile so much. I’m told he’s very happy. He’s doing a great job. So I definitely hope to run into him there in Cincinnati,” McCarthy said. Alan Saunders provided reporting from Pittsburgh. item.title: Harry Kane breaks England appearance record and presented with gifts ahead of Croatia clash
item.description: Harry Kane has broken Peter Shilton ’s appearance record for the England men’s team after playing against Croatia in the Nations League at Wembley this evening. Thomas Tuchel had already confirmed at his pre-match press conference on Wednesday that his captain Kane would start the match and that was rubber-stamped when the teams were released an hour and 15 minutes before kick-off. It is the 33-year-old’s first game for his country since winning the Ballon d’Or last month and will be his record 126th England cap, meaning he surpasses Shilton atop the list. Harry Kane broke the England appearance record (PA) The legendary goalkeeper presented Kane – who has also scored a record 91 goals for the Three Lions – with a special golden crest ahead of the match at Wembley to celebrate the milestone. During the short ceremony ahead of kick-off, Kane was given a replica of the ball that Englishmen brought to Croatia in 1880 to start their love affair with football. That was presented by Croatia captain Luka Modric. Prince William also presented Kane with a framed England shirt with ‘Kane 126’ on the back before the English trio posed for photos. Harry Kane, Prince William and Peter Shilton all were involved in the pre-match celebration (Reuters) Kane was also re-presented with hi Ballon d’Or trophy (PA) Kane was then re-presented with his Ballon d’Or trophy after last month’s triumph as the crowd saluted their hero and unfurled a huge tifo of the striker. The Independent’s chief sports writer Lawrence Ostlere was at Wembley and said: “A nice moment here at Wembley to mark Harry Kane’s extraordinary career, with his children on the pitch. The highlight was undoubtedly Prince William ushering Peter Shilton to come and join in the group photo with Kane, like a very weird family holiday.” It was an emotional and celebratory atmosphere for the man who many consider to be England’s greatest player of all-time. England boss Tuchel wrote in his programme notes: “It’s the perfect place to celebrate Harry Kane and his recent achievements. There’s something quite poetic about the fact that almost a week or so after he was named England’s first Ballon d’Or winner for over 25 years, he’s now on the cusp of becoming the country’s all-time record caps holder. It’s so special not just for Harry but for all of us. “He has had a very special few weeks and the scary thing is, he is getting better and better, and even more influential. Winning the Ballon d’Or and becoming the all-time appearance record holder are both huge achievements, and I think it’s really important that he gets to celebrate these moments in front of our fans – because everyone should be proud. “Harry is humble, and he is very aware that everything is a team effort. He is a true leader and a true team player, which makes our number nine very special. So, he deserves all the credit, and hopefully he keeps on doing what he does best… scoring goals for us.” Kane won the Ballon d’Or last month (AFP/Getty) Eng

item.title: Texans vs. Browns Week 10 picks: Cleveland being treated like an afterthought
item.description: The Cleveland Browns take on the Houston Texans this Sunday. The Browns are 3-0 at home this year, but after having lost two straight games, they are being treated like an afterthought this week. As you can see in the national picks below, not a single person is picking the Browns at home. Here is what the national media is saying about the Week 10 game between the Browns and Texans: NFL.com (Various) Why Brooke picked the Texans: Even sitting at 3-5, the Texans appear to be full steam ahead toward a playoff berth with the way their offense is playing and defense is improving. C.J. Stroud has Nick Caley’s unit absolutely humming now that most of his main targets are healthy. The real key to that success is Nico Collins. In the 257 snaps Collins has played this season, the Texans have averaged 8.2 yards per passing play, more than the 49ers’ league-leading 7.9. He could be stalled when matched up against cornerback Denzel Ward, who’s allowing 0.5 yards per coverage snap, fifth-fewest among cornerbacks (min. 150 coverage snaps). That duel is sure to be dogfight Sunday, but no matter, as I have faith in Stroud’s other weapons (Tank Dell, Marvin Harrison Jr., Kayshon Boutte and Xavier Hutchinson) to get it done. Houston’s lone offensive weakness matches up nicely against the Browns’ permeable run defense. Getting Deshaun Watson back is a boost for Cleveland, but even with him, the Browns have struggled to put together a full game, instead relying on a few big plays each week from their young stars. An all-around performance is exactly what the Browns must have to beat the current version of DeMeco Ryans’ team. Thus, Cleveland will fall short of improving to 4-0 at home for the first time since the 1963 campaign, when Jim Brown led the NFL in rushing and scrimmage yards in a 14-game season. CBS Sports (Pete Prisco) – Texans 21, Browns 20 This is a big game for both teams in terms of the playoff picture. The Texans looked dominant against the Chargers last week, but this is a second straight road game. It won’t matter. Their defensive front will dominate whoever plays quarterback for the Browns. But the Cleveland defense will keep them in it. CBS Sports (John Breech) – Texans 24, Browns 16 Anyway, this genuinely does feel like a game that’s going to boil down to Watson vs. the Texans. Watson has been sacked more times than any other QB in the NFL this year (33), and he’ll be facing a defense that leads the NFL in sacks (29). That’s a recipe for disaster. There have only been three games all season where a QB has been sacked at least eight times: Two of them were Deshaun Watson (vs. Jets in Week 5 and vs. Steelers in Week 8) and the other one happened on Sunday with the Texans sacking Justin Herbert eight times. Sporting News (Vinnie Iyer) – Texans 20, Browns 17 The Texans hope to sneak back into the playoff picture and their defense got back to making big plays in Los Angeles after the bye. item.title: Braves Sign Evan Phillips To $35 Million Deal Eight Years After Trading Him Away
item.description: Atlanta Braves pitcher Evan Phillips The Atlanta Braves have made the first big splash in free agency by signing former Los Angeles Dodgers reliever Evan Phillips to a three-year, $35 million deal. The Braves announced in a press release that Phillips will make $11 million in 2027 and 2028, and $13 million in 2029. He will also donate 1% of his salary to the Atlanta Braves Foundation. The Braves originally drafted Phillips in the 2015 MLB Draft, and he made his MLB debut with them in 2018. He was traded to the Baltimore Orioles that same year in a deal that landed the Braves Kevin Gausman and Darren O'Day. Since then, he has also played for the Tampa Bay Rays and the Los Angeles Dodgers. He has been with the Dodgers since 2021 and has been key in their success. Since joining the Dodgers, he has posted a 2.36 ERA in 232 games. From 2022-2024, he pitched in 187 games with a 2.21 ERA and notched 44 saves. In 2025, he underwent Tommy John surgery and did not return until July of last season. Looking for the perfect gift for a baseball player in your life? Check out our brand new baseball lifestyle brand! Last season, he ended up pitching in 31 regular-season games with a 3.46 ERA. He also threw three scoreless innings in the postseason. Phillips is 32 years old and still has some good baseball left in him. The Braves won't need him to close games, as they already have Robert Suárez, who is very capable of closing games if Raisel Iglesias leaves in free agency. If Iglesias does return, the Braves will have an even better bullpen than last season, with Phillips now in the mix as well. Phillips won the World Series with the Dodgers in 2024, throwing 6 2/3 scoreless innings in the postseason. He was injured for the World Series run in 2025, however. item.title: Sophie Cunningham names the LA Lakers player she should be compared to instead of Luka Doncic
item.description: Photo by Sean M. Haffey/Getty Images WNBA star Sophie Cunningham instantly distanced herself from a statistical comparison to Luka Doncic, and pointed the conversation in another direction. Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham discussed the Los Angeles Lakers on the latest episode of the No Hesitation podcast. Luka Doncic is averaging a stunning 38.6 ppg this season for the Western Conference leaders, putting himself in the MVP conversation. To point out just how prolific Doncic’s scoring streak is, podcast host Drew Hanlen pointed out that he is attempting almost as many shots this season as Sophie Cunningham did the entire WNBA season, and has already overtaken her for free-throws. He said: “Through his first nine games, he has attempted 221 shots. Last season in 43 games, you attempted 226 shots, so he is five behind you this season…. The second thing is, Luka has attempted 102 free throws already after nine games, and last season you attempted 74.” Sophie Cunningham asks for fairer comparison Sophie Cunningham pointed out that Luka Doncic makes a huge amount more money than she does. And instead, she asked to be compared to another Los Angeles Lakers players who she shares a more similar level of production with. She said: “And I also think you’re missing a big one: he also makes $50 million a year. I make $700,000 on my WNBA check. “You should compare me more to Quentin Grimes, we average around eight to 10 points, I think that’s it. My three-point shooting is actually better than the both of them. So if we’re going to compare, let’s compare.” It should be pointed out that Quentin Grimes is coming off the bench this season for the Lakers. His best season averaged was in 2024-25 where he posted 14.6ppg split across his spells with the Dallas Mavericks and Philadelphia 76ers. His 28-game spell exclusively with the Sixers saw him post 21.9 ppg. Sophie Cunningham’s best scoring WNBA regular season was in 2022 with the Phoenix Mercury, where she averaged 12.6 points per game. Grimes is making $13.9m with the Lakers this season as part of a four-year $60m deal signed in the offseason.

item.title: 2027: ‘Arrest perpetrators’, Senate condemns political violence nationwide
item.description: By Henry Umoru AHEAD of 2027 Presidential and general elections, the Senate has condemned in very strong terms, cases of political violence, attacks and disruption of political activities across the country. The Senate has thus taken a swipe at acts of violence, intimidation, assault and destruction of property associated with political rallies, meetings, processions and other lawful political activities, irrespective of the political parties or individuals affected. The Senate has urged the security agents to as a matter of urgency apprehend whoever is culpable in such heinous act in order to serve as deterrent to others. The Upper Chamber has called on all political parties, candidates and their supporters to reject inflammatory rhetoric, discourage violence and cooperate with security agencies in maintaining public peace. Speaking with Vanguard yesterday, Chairman of the Senate Committee on Media and Public Affairs, Senator Yemi Adaramodu, APC, Ekiti South, said, “President Bola Ahmed Tinubu is preaching peace and national harmony, the National Assembly is in support of Mr President on this. “We thus condemn in totality any act of political violence and urge the security agents to apprehend whoever is culpable in such heinous act.” Vanguard News The post 2027: ‘Arrest perpetrators’, Senate condemns political violence nationwide appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.description: Super Eagles head coach Eric Chelle has explained his decision to leave goalkeeper Maduka Okoye out of Nigeria’s squad for their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) qualifying matches. Chelle, who is preparing the Super Eagles for their double-header against Tanzania, said his selection decisions were based on considerations both on and off the pitch. The Franco-Malian tactician insisted that the national team was not obligated to any particular player, stressing that his choices were guided by his assessment of what was best for the squad. “The national team is not close to him or anyone. I made my choice and when I made my choice I made it around the pitch and outside it,” Chelle said. Okoye, who plays for Italian club Udinese, has been absent from recent Super Eagles selections, with Stanley Nwabali, Francis Uzoho and Arthur Okonkwo among the goalkeepers considered by the coach. Chelle’s latest comments underline his position that selection for the national team is based on his technical and other considerations rather than a player’s reputation or status. The Super Eagles are seeking to strengthen their position in the AFCON 2027 qualifying campaign as they prepare to face Tanzania in two crucial Group L encounters.
